name: decaying-reproach-removes-wither-counters-for-extra-damage
notes: Decaying Reproach: removes up to four wither counters from objects you don't control, then deals 3 + 2X damage (X = counters removed). Pre-fix always 3 ($removed undefined).

rulesClauses: Deal 3+X damage to target unit, where X is twice the amount of wither counters removed.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Decaying Reproach: the generated handler ($removed) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
